description: For a nonnegative rational q whose square is below two, (2q+2)/(q+2) is greater than q and also has square below two.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.ConstructingNumberSystems.sqrtTwo_improvement (q : ℚ) (hq : 0 ≤ q) (hq2 : q ^ 2 < 2) :
  q < (2 * q + 2) / (q + 2) ∧ ((2 * q + 2) / (q + 2)) ^ 2 < 2
